scope.input_domain: Both root teachings normalized to styā on the selected account; retain both. The four prefix contexts are counted once each, with two suffix families, three genders and 24 cases/numbers. Optional t/m belongs to the same requested cell.

operator_history.bare_or_sam: Under 6.1.45, ai to ā before non-śit niṣṭhā. The consonant-initial cluster, ā and y now satisfy 8.2.43. Niṣṭhā t becomes n. Sam does not license 6.1.23 on its own.
operator_history.pra: 6.1.23 selects root-internal y for saṃprasāraṇa; 6.1.108 gives the preceding vowel reading and 6.4.2 supplies length. The resulting stī has no original y/ā environment left for 8.2.43. Optional 8.2.54 changes niṣṭhā t to m. Retain prastīta and prastīma.
operator_history.pra+sam: The adjective prapūrva describes the whole preverb/root complex, so 6.1.23 still supplies stī with intervening sam. The Padamañjarī explicitly blocks m of 8.2.54 here. Only the t branch survives. The diagnostic applies both to kta and ktavatu.

sources.compared_unprefixed_fields: Both Vidyut-archived root records have t in the kta and ktavatu stem, so each differs from the n prediction of the Kāśikā/Kaumudī source selection. These are four affected root/affix fields. Source provenance is preserved. The other kṛt archive agrees for the two fields supplied under 01.1058.
